meta.conventions: world X,Y horizontal, Z up, right-handed; eta = sum a cos(k(X cos th + Y sin th) - w t + phi); pose z = CG height above calm water; Blender rotation_euler (roll, pitch, yaw) mode XYZ; pitch > 0 = bow down

hull.name: scarab195
hull.note: body frame from the CG: x forward, y left, z up; stations from transom to stem; section = keel (0, zk), chine (+-yc, zk + min(yc tan(beta), depth)), deck edge (+-yc, zk + depth); yc = b/2 sqrt(1 - s^2) over the forward taper (s 0..1), keel flat (stem_rise 0) -- the plant's prismatic hull, not a CAD model
